skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 50% ATK DMG to a single target with 2 combo strikes.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 30% ATK DMG to each enemy in a column with 5 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on the main target for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. rate by 35%).

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Deals 30% ATK DMG to each enemy in a column with 5 combo strikes, with a 100% chance to inflict [Shatter] on the main target and a 50% chance on same-column targets for 2 turns (reduces DMG RED. rate by 35%).

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When defeating an enemy, deals 100% ATK bonus DMG to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage. Can be triggered up to 2 times.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When defeating an enemy, deals 120% ATK bonus DMG to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage. Can be triggered up to 4 times.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Permanently increases own HP. When defeating an enemy, deals 130% ATK bonus DMG to the enemy with the lowest HP percentage. Can be triggered up to 4 times.
